title: Cyber resilience: building confidence as threats evolve
summary: Speech by Mark Francis, director of specialists at the Cyber Security in Financial Services Summit. There is no shortage of material for a speech about cyber security at the moment.Recent months have provided some stark reminders of just how interconnected our digital economy has become.Major outages affecting Microsoft and Google have shown how problems in one part of the system can reverberate widely.We are seeing that changing environment reflected in our own data too.Last month was the highest month for cyber incidents reported to the FCA in the past 18 months, and the second highest in the past 5 years.And those numbers sit against a broader shift in the operating environment.Financial services firms are increasingly reliant on complex networks of technology and third-party providers.Geopolitical tensions remain heightened.And technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and the potential emergence of quantum computing are changing what is possible for attackers and defenders alike.Put all of that together and you could be forgiven for thinking this might be quite a gloomy speech.But I am, by nature, an optimist.
